scope: Repair eight extra notifications on disclosed first-lift detector. Preserve the earlier method and its failure.
physics: A weak settled load, rather than the leading edge of a large or tangential pulse. Two independent adjacent 8-sample blocks must support the same sign of vertical load. The inverse estimate cannot be growing faster than its measured clearance/noise allowance. Reject a source reaching the native vertical force budget; hand native the rest of that excursion. Never suppress a parent sample.
units: N, actual measured height, samples at the documented 1 kHz
thresholds: parent's existing calibrated vertical force threshold; preceding geometry-calibrated bound normal-only; 0.75 N or 12.5% of the mean (2 of 16 samples) plateau tolerance
preservation: No new earlier hidden panels. Score historical normals, real tool contact, all 180 impacts and paired events separately; only the single pre-registered composition is eligible for a new test.
